reviews.title: Close AS2 Areas 2-5 Boolean, Selection, ContextMenu, setMask and showRedrawRegions gaps
reviews.summary: Supports boxed new Boolean(v) alongside primitive Boolean(v), string and relative target paths in Selection.setFocus() and MovieClip.setMask() with cached soft alpha masking, all eight ContextMenuBuiltInItems flags with live loop/quality/zoom actions, and Canvas/DOM dirty-bounds outlines for showRedrawRegions().

entries.note: Boolean(v) returns primitive boolean (undefined with 0 args in AS2) while new Boolean(v) constructs a boxed Boolean object with valueOf, toString, instanceof Boolean, and truthy object branching.
Focuses live MovieClip, Button, and TextField instances or resolves absolute and caller-relative string target paths, clearing focus on null/undefined and returning false on unresolved paths.
Supports all eight ContextMenuBuiltInItems flags (save, zoom, quality, play, loop, rewind, forward_back, print), hideBuiltInItems(), copy(), and live loop/quality/zoom menu actions.
Accepts live MovieClip instances, absolute or relative string target paths, and null clearing, including soft alpha masking when cacheAsBitmap is enabled on both maskee and mask.
Connects publication redraw_regions and 24-bit RGB color state to Canvas strokeRect outlines and the DOM redraw-region overlay around updated display bounds, clearing cleanly when disabled.
